title: Pair across teams, agents included
tagline: You bring your agent and they bring theirs. Work one problem in one thread and keep what you decide.
needs: A teammate with their own coding agent and a hub you can both reach
A problem that touches both your parts of the code
takeaway: A way to work across a team boundary where the agents carry each side's context.
outcomes: Put both people and both agents on one problem
Steer while the agents do the legwork across both codebases
Settle a disagreement once and keep the decision

video.about: Inviting a teammate and asking their agent directly in one task's thread.
Agents each suggest an option and rate them all. The least happy one proposes a fix, everyone settles on it, and the decision is kept.

quiz.question: Concord got web and api to agree. Where does the outcome live?
options: In a decision memory saved for the task
In a new row on the board
quiz.why: A thread scrolls away. Concord saves its decision under context/decision/, and later work in the task is shown it.
